'''Tott Doneeta's courier''' was the elegant transport [[Tott Doneeta]] used to travel from [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to [[Exis Station/Legends|Exis Station]]. It had a grappling line, which Tott used to grab onto [[Vima Sunrider]]'s [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], keeping Vima from being destroyed by the star [[Teedio]].<ref name="Redemption 1" />
